items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: I ran into Nick Brignola and Sid Jacobs and music publishers, and Loren Treola and Booker

ctx.x: It’s amazing to watch the veteran musicians especially, try to walk down the hall. There are so many people you run into and you have to have a conversation.

You know just getting here was pretty hard. I ran into Nick Brignola and Sid Jacobs and music publishers, and Loren Treola and Booker, and I could go on and on, just getting from the lobby, which is not that crowded at this hour. This is four o’clock in the morning? What time is it now?
